indications_and_usage.t: Uses As first aid to help prevent skin infection in minor cuts n scrapes n burns Warnings n For external use only

dosage_and_administration.t: Directions Clean the affected area, apply a small amount on the area 1 to 3 times daily. May be covered with a sterile bandage. If bandaged, let dry first.

warnings.t: Warnings For external use only Ask a doctor before use. if you have deep or puncture wounds, animal bites or serious burns. When using this product. do not use in eyes or apply over large areas of the body. do not use longer than 1 week unless directed by a doctor. Stop use and ask a doctor if condition persists or gets worse
